context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 13:01 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (ruling): rule verification-recovery-independent-of-state (a recovery control must not depend on the state it recovers), cited by the coordinator.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: The mailbox stays off on your Mac until its check passes, and you can still run that check.
options.how: PR #2849 holds the mail command on your Mac, and setting MAILBOX_HOLD_OFF=1 on one command lets it run for the Mac check. Undo: drop the flag.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: Your Mac check commands need the extra MAILBOX_HOLD_OFF=1 at the front.

options.gain: Your Mac check commands stay as they are.
options.how: No opt-out: the hold blocks every mail command on your Mac until it is lifted.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: The Mac check cannot run while the hold is on, so the hold cannot be lifted by passing it.

reply: Filed: the pick stands. Mail stays held on your Mac, and putting MAILBOX_HOLD_OFF=1 in front of a mail command runs it for your Mac check (PR #2849).
title: The Mac mail hold has a one-command opt-out so your Mac check still runs
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
